seo.title: Local Text to Speech (TTS) Generator
seo.description: Synthesize natural-sounding spoken audio from text locally in your browser. Runs completely client-side using WebAssembly and ONNX Runtime.
seo.keywords: text to speech, tts, speech synthesis, local tts, piper, vits, webassembly, onnx runtime

help.title: How it works:
help.worker: ONNX Runtime compiles the speech model in a background Web Worker.
help.firstRun: The first generation downloads the selected voice model (~15-40MB).
help.cache: Downloaded models are stored in the browser cache (OPFS) for instant, offline generation on subsequent attempts.

about.title: About Local Web-TTS (VITS)
about.description: Traditional text-to-speech systems rely on cloud servers (like Google TTS or OpenAI Audio) to process text and return audio streams. This tool compiles and performs neural text-to-speech inference completely in your browser, maintaining full privacy and working completely offline.
about.advantagePrivate: Your input text never leaves your device.
about.advantageCost: Performs rendering utilizing your client CPU.
about.advantageOffline: Caches models using the Origin Private File System (OPFS).
about.vits: End-to-end Variational Inference with Adversarial Learning.
about.onnx: WebAssembly backend for fast neural network execution in the browser.
about.piper: Rhasspy's Piper project weights optimized for clean, speech synthesis.

errors.workersUnsupported: Web Workers are not supported in this browser. Synthesis cannot run.
